verdict.rationale: Metorial's docs confirm it runs OAuth flows so users can authorize third-party services (Slack, GitHub, Google Calendar) and that each user's own credentials are kept scoped rather than shared broad service accounts, implying some credential vaulting per user (metorial-docs-4, metorial-docs-31). However, there is no explicit documentation of encryption-at-rest for stored tokens or of automatic token refresh, and community feedback explicitly flags that the auth handling isn't clearly documented (metorial-comm-2), reinforcing the gap rather than contradicting the OAuth capability itself. Missing for 10: explicit encryption-at-rest details, documented automatic token refresh mechanism, and independent verification of secure credential storage.
